story_text:
[画像: Project We Love]
[画像: More AI. More Apps. More Things to Control.]
You jump between apps.
You switch between windows.
You open AI tools.
You copy, paste, click, type, and repeat.
And somehow, even with all this technology, work can still feel complicated.
[画像: ComboX in the News]
[画像: What if you could take control, and actually enjoy it?]
## ⌨️ Meet ComboX
[画像: Meet ComboX]
[画像: ComboX desk setups]
## Key Features
[画像: Made for Every Interaction]
ComboX puts the controls you use most right at your fingertips. ComboX brings physical controls, software automation, AI access, workspace navigation, and customization, all in one compact console.
[画像: ComboX product 3D animation]
## 🤖 AI Link
[画像: AI Link: Your AI. One Action Away.]
AI can help you explain, translate, summarize, search, rewrite, reply, and create. But reaching the right AI with the right context still takes too many steps.
[画像: The usual way vs ComboX AI Link]
Press a key, drag to capture the text or content you need, and ComboX automatically sends it to your selected AI service with your preset prompt.
[画像: AI Link Mark & Edit demo]
Examples
- Explain
- Translate
- Summarize
- Rewrite / Improve
- Search
- Reply
- Custom Prompt
- Mark & Edit
※ AI Link works with external AI services such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and others. Available functions and usage may vary depending on each service's features, policies, and the user's account or subscription.
Press and Talk.
Simply press a key to activate voice input in Codex or Claude Code, then speak your command instead of typing. Available on the installed desktop versions of Codex and Claude Code.
Note: Uses your computer’s built-in or connected microphone. ComboX does not have a built-in microphone.
[画像: AI Link Press and Talk demo]
## 🕹️ Virtual Desktop Control
[画像: Move Through Your Digital Workspace]
[画像: Your computer may have dozens of windows open, but your work has different spaces.]
Instead of searching through windows or remembering multi-key shortcuts, use the joystick to move naturally between your virtual workspaces. With ComboX, you can navigate Windows Virtual Desktops or macOS Spaces with a simple physical control. Organize each desktop around a specific purpose, then switch between them with a quick flick of the joystick.
Example
- Desktop 1: Slack, Teams, Email
- Desktop 2: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini
- Desktop 3: Premiere, Photoshop, Figma
- Desktop 4: VS Code, Terminal, GitHub
[画像: Switching between Desktop 1–4]
## Multi Action
[画像: One Press. Multiple Actions.]
Opening one app is easy. Starting a real task often means opening several apps, websites, folders, files, and tools in the right order. With Multi Action, combine multiple actions into one button and choose how they run.
[画像: Start My Workday]
Simultaneous Action: Launch multiple independent actions together.
Sequential Action: Run actions in a defined order when one step needs to happen before the next.
[画像: Multi Action editor: add, copy, paste, or delete actions in a few clicks.]
[画像: Combo Action: Enter a Sequence. Trigger Something Special.]
Combo Action turns repetitive transitions into something that feels more like a game command than a utility shortcut.
## ⚡ One Tap Combo Action
[画像: Combo Action editor: set a combo command, then build the list of actions it runs.]
- Work Kickoff: Enter your command and launch the apps, project folders, AI tools, and music you need.
- Game Time: Finish work, switch desktops, open Discord and Steam, change the mood, and play.
- Secret Action: Open a personal project, hidden folder, or saved text through your own sequence.
[画像: Your Tools. Now Under Your Fingers.]
Your workflow already lives across dozens of apps. ComboX brings your most-used controls closer to you.
With software plugins, ComboX can connect with the tools you already use for creative work, streaming, productivity, and communication, turning frequently used commands and actions into physical controls at your fingertips.
[画像: Easy action mapping]
Live Streaming & Video Editing
Bring your streaming and video editing shortcuts to ComboX. Switch scenes, control audio, trigger sound effects, start recording, navigate your timeline, and make cuts, all with your favorite controls at your fingertips.
[画像: Video editing with ComboX]
Add More with Free Plug-ins.
Start with AI Link and built-in presets, then expand your setup with around 60 free plug-ins. Download the ones you need and add new shortcuts to ComboX in just a few clicks.
## Software & Plug-ins
[画像: Presets and free plug-ins]
As the ComboX ecosystem grows, more apps, plugins, and workflow possibilities can be added, so your console can evolve with the way you work.
※ Supported software and plugin functionality may vary depending on the software version and available integrations. The final supported software list will be clearly specified based on the versions supported at launch.
[画像: One Console. Different Workflows.]
[画像: For AI Power Users, AI Builders & Developers, Creators & Professionals, Streamers & Power Users]
## 📱 Mobile Mode
[画像: Your Shortcuts, Even on Mobile.]
Not every workflow happens at a desk.
When you’re working on an iPad, iPhone, or Android device, you often have to rely on on-screen menus, gestures, or software panels to access the tools you use most.
ComboX gives you another way to interact.
Switch ComboX into Mobile Mode and bring your favorite shortcuts and controls to supported mobile workflows. Assign frequently used actions to physical keys, so you can keep your hands on the work instead of constantly reaching for menus on screen.
Shortcut support may vary by app. Mobile Mode uses the shortcuts supported by each app, so available functions and controls may vary depending on the app.
Example: Clip Studio Paint on iPad
- Undo / Redo
- Eraser / Tool Switch
- Brush Size
- Add Layer
- Canvas Rotation / Zoom
[画像: Mobile Mode demo]
## 🎨 Personalized Design
[画像: Your Desk. Your Style.]
[画像: Swap the switches. Mix the keycaps.]
ComboX is more than a productivity tool. It’s a desktop gadget designed to be used, touched, customized, and enjoyed. From the LCD background and key backlighting to the switches, keycaps, joystick cap, UI theme, and labels, you can personalize the details to match your style, setup, and workflow.
- LCD Background: Use your own images, pixel art, icons, or layouts.
- Key Backlight: Set colors by mood, layer, or function.
- Hot-swappable Switches & Keycaps: Replace switches and keycaps to match your feel and style.
- Joystick Cap: Change the physical look and feel.
- UI Themes & Labels: Customize the interface around your workflow.
[画像: Built to Feel Physical. Designed to Stay Flexible.]
[画像: Hardware]
[画像: Software]
[画像: OS Support: Windows 10/11 and Apple Silicon Macs. Intel-based Macs are not supported.]
## Why We Built ComboX
[画像: Technology keeps getting smarter.]
But as technology evolves, keeping up can sometimes feel like more work. What if keeping up could feel less like work, and more like play?
We believe interacting with technology should feel more intuitive, engaging, and enjoyable. That’s why we built ComboX.
Work has changed. We now move between more apps, more AI services, more tabs, and more specialized tools than ever before. Traditional shortcuts can make individual actions faster, but they do not necessarily make the entire experience simpler or more enjoyable.
So we built ComboX around a different idea: productivity should feel intuitive, tactile, and even playful. AI Link brings AI closer. Virtual Desktop Control makes digital spaces physical. Multi Action turns repetitive setups into one action. Combo Action turns transitions into a ritual you can actually enjoy.
This is where the name comes from.
- Combo connects tools, actions, and workflows.
- X is the intersection of work and play, where productivity multiplies.
That’s the idea behind ComboX.
[画像: From Idea to Production.]
ComboX began with a simple goal: as work grows more complex with more apps and more AI, make it easier, and more enjoyable, to control. Rather than building just another macro keyboard, we brought AI Link, automation, joystick-based workspace switching, and Combo Action together in one console. We didn't set out to build just a faster work tool. We set out to make working itself feel more intuitive, and more fun.
After three rounds of prototyping and the completion of production tooling in May 2026, ComboX is now ready for mass production.
[画像: ComboX line drawing]
[画像: Work Like Play.]
## Product Specs
[画像: Product specifications]
ComboX does not offer wireless connectivity. By connecting directly to your PC via USB-C, ComboX prioritizes stable power and perfectly reliable communication without the risk of latency or interference.
[画像: Choose Your Color]
## 🎁 Rewards
[画像: Early backer rewards]
Shipping, taxes and duties are not included.
ComboX comes in Retro Gray, Pure White, and Jet Black. You'll choose the color for each unit in the post-campaign backer survey.
## 📦 What's Included
[画像: What's in the Box]
[画像: ComboX packaging]
[画像: Inside the box]
## 🚚 Shipping Info
[画像: Shipping info]
Shipping fees are not collected during the campaign. Shipping will be calculated based on actual rates for your destination and charged separately after the campaign through the pledge manager, where we will also securely collect your shipping details.
We currently ship to the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, European Union, Australia, Japan, Taiwan, Singapore, Malaysia, and South Korea. Import duties and VAT are not included and are the backer's responsibility.
[画像: Taxes, Customs, and Fees]
Our logistics partners will make every effort to minimize additional fees upon delivery. However, as these fees are determined by your country’s local customs regulations, taxes, and policies, we cannot confirm all charges. Any additional charges incurred after the initial dispatch of the ComboX will be the responsibility of the recipient.
Due to the unpredictable nature, and varying policies for each country and delivery region, we cannot cover these fees in advance or include them in our shipping fees. We invite all backers to double-check their local policies regarding imports from other countries, as the product will be dispatched from its manufacturing country, Republic of Korea. Changes or reductions of the product's declared value, product type, or product made cannot be made.
Shipping to Remote Locations
If your shipping address is usually considered a 'remote location' additional delivery charges may be incurred upon dispatch due to our shipping providers’ policies.

risks: As with any hardware project, ComboX carries some risk. Supply chain issues, certification timelines, or manufacturing challenges could delay production, and small design details may change during mass production to improve quality and manufacturability. We've already completed multiple prototype rounds and secured production tooling to minimize these risks. If anything changes, we'll notify all backers promptly through Kickstarter Updates. Thank you for trusting us on this journey!

faq.a: Shipping is scheduled to begin in January 2027. Delivery times may vary by country due to shipping and customs, and we'll keep you updated through Kickstarter as fulfillment progresses.
ComboX has gone through multiple rounds of prototyping and testing. We've completed mass-production tooling and key certifications, and we're currently preparing for mass production.
Windows 10 / 11 and macOS on Apple Silicon Macs (M1 or later). ComboX is not compatible with Intel-based Macs.

ComboX does not offer wireless connectivity. By connecting directly to your PC via USB-C, ComboX prioritizes stable power and perfectly reliable communication without the risk of latency or interference.
The dedicated ComboX software lets you configure keys, the dial, the joystick, profiles, and various actions. The AI Link feature also requires installing the ComboX Chrome extension.

No subscription is required to use ComboX's core hardware and dedicated software. If you use AI Link with external AI services like ChatGPT or Gemini, availability depends on your own account and plan with those services.

faq.q: Can I use ComboX without AI?
faq.a: Yes. AI Link is just one of ComboX's many features. App launching, shortcuts, macros, media control, and more are all available without AI.
ComboX is built to control major AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude.

faq.q: Can I freely customize the keys?
faq.a: Yes. You can assign any function to each key, and the hot-swap switches and keycaps are also replaceable.

faq.q: What can the joystick and dial be used for?
faq.a: They can be used for screen navigation, scrolling, media control, adjusting values, and other custom functions.

faq.q: Can I run multiple actions at once?
faq.a: Yes. You can combine multiple commands and actions into a single workflow that runs with one press.

faq.q: Can I create different profiles for different programs?
faq.a: Yes. You can create and use up to 7 profile (layer) sets tailored to the programs or workflows you use.

faq.q: Will new features be added after launch?
faq.a: Yes. We'll continue improving ComboX and adding new features through software and firmware updates.
ComboX is CE, RoHS, FCC, and KC compliant.
